subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should the repository accept the v1.11 Codex action and related credential-bearing GitHub Action revisions after direct contract inspection and a trusted workflow run?
rationale: This is a trust and credential-boundary decision over third-party executable workflow code; the bot-generated pin update and ordinary CI results cannot establish the intended acceptance boundary alone.
